test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 10th December 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Six persons, A, B, C, D, E and F, are sitting in a straight line, all facing the same direction. E is sitting between B and F. A is third to the right of F. E is fourth to the left of A. C is not sitting next to A. Who is sitting between F and D?
solution:
Six persons, A, B, C, D, E and F, are sitting in a straight line, all facing the same direction.

1) E is sitting between B and F.

Case(i) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47567a066300a504588912dd7d3153de577b01d3a2b599465bad1ca12c8d4cd9.png] 

Case(ii) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b1059a38755935a4c4e72db0eb7f31b84e00bbbcd994f2440bc9860ebbf77cdf.png] 

2) A is third to the right of F and E is fourth to the left of A.

Case(i) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e4d208c530b8adaa82b29bafb45c1131d71a6f00c50fdc9d13f5490234183bd6.png] 

Case(ii) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e4849f7ec9df8fc77c4fe2c0dc1e8759287bee35d8cd73925ce391b89d49ffa4.png] 

Here case (ii) gets eliminated.

3) C is not sitting next to A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3679f4e9b734b32bcbc5e80a8fe1b644311a1cc3958ae10e69061f31a15e3f7.png] 

∴ Here, 'C' is sitting between F and D.

Hence, the correct answer is **"C".**
